detailed_description: The Text Similarity Compare tool compares two pasted text values directly in the browser. When both textareas contain text, it calculates a character similarity percentage from a Levenshtein edit distance, a word similarity percentage from shared lowercase word tokens, the edit distance number, and a common-word count over the combined word set. The results update from the two text inputs and are shown as four summary cards. It does not offer selectable similarity algorithms, TF-IDF or cosine similarity, n-gram analysis, stemming, stopword removal, synchronized diff views, heatmaps, plagiarism detection, file import, or detailed operation matrices.
usage_steps: Paste or type the first text in the first textarea.
Paste or type the second text in the second textarea.
Review the character similarity percentage once both inputs contain text.
Check the word similarity, edit distance, and common-word count summary cards.
usage_examples: Compare two short text snippets to see a quick character similarity percentage.
Check how many lowercase word tokens are shared between two pasted paragraphs.
Use the edit distance card as a simple indicator of how much two strings differ.
Compare draft wording variations without importing files or choosing algorithms.
